title: Alhambra
text: Great in depth tour with plenty of historical knowledge from our guide of this amazing place. Highly recommend it. Transportation comfortable and driver was also very helpful with pick-up/drop-off locations.  5-stars!
author: Michael_W

title: Jose our driver and...
text: Jose our driver and Enrique our tour guide were amazing.   Both had a lot of knowledge and were very pleasant.
author: Faisal_A

title: This ended up being more...
text: This ended up being more like a private tour as there were no other customers added to our group. Rafa was an excellent driver and very accommodating. Enrique is an amazing guide for the tour.  Recommend using him as much as possible.
author: David_K

title: Great day trip from Seville!
text:
Our driver Rafael was great. He changed the pick up spot to be closer to us.
Our guide at the Alhambra was very knowledgeable and friendly
The Alhambra is beautiful!
Great day trip from Seville!
author: Cindy_H

title: The best driver & tour guide
text:
Our private transfer to Alhambra by Rafa was first class. He messaged us in the morning of the pickup, gave us a coffee break en route due to the long drive time, took care of us meeting our Alhambra guide, communicated with us for the pickup point back, arranged another coffee break and dropped us off in the city at a location convenient for our evening’s plans. He was wonderful company all day, and he was very familiar with our home country of Scotland which made for great conversations.

title: Incredible experience!
text: We had a such a great experience in the Alhambra.  Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and took his time to explained.
author: sabinayi

title: My favorite tour in all of Spain
text: I was picked up where indicated and I was grateful the driver had my number as he contacted me when there.  I was by myself so this was very helpful.   After the drive to Granada I met the tour group but not before the driver made sure I was there.  He also kept in contact with taking me back.  While the tour was wonderful the driver was an essential part of this tour making me feel safe as a solo traveler
author: Lori_L
